title: Civic
description: A node in the civics tree, adopted with culture points. Its effects are the only source of unlocks for buildings, recipes, tiers, traditions and festivals. One file per civic in content/civics/<id>.json.

requires.description: The civics that must be adopted first.

inspiration.description: A condition that cuts the node's cost when it is met.

gateway.description: Whether completing it is one half of an era transition. Exactly one tech and one civic per transition are gateways.

repeatable.description: Makes the node repeatable at a growing cost.
